keyEvents.text: Substitution, Middlesbrough. Myles Peart-Harris replaces Sebastian Berhalter.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. Max Arfsten replaces Luke Ayling.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. Riley McGree replaces Kyle Joseph.
George Dobson (Wrexham) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Wrexham 1, Middlesbrough 0. George Thomason (Wrexham) left footed shot from outside the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Kieffer Moore with a headed pass.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. David Strelec replaces Neto Borges.
Substitution, Wrexham. Oliver Rathbone replaces George Thomason.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. Jeremy Sarmiento replaces Tommy Conway.
Substitution, Wrexham. Ben Sheaf replaces George Dobson.
Goal! Wrexham 2, Middlesbrough 0. Oliver Rathbone (Wrexham) header from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Lewis O'Brien with a cross.
